name: Wait
description: Pause workflow execution for a specified time delay

block.name: Wait
block.description: Pause workflow execution for a specified time delay
block.longDescription: Pauses workflow execution for a specified time interval. The wait executes a simple sleep for the configured duration.
block.bestPractices:
- Use for simple time delays (max 10 minutes)
- Configure the wait amount and unit (seconds or minutes)
- Time-based waits are interruptible via workflow cancellation
- Enter a positive number for the wait amount

status.description: Status of the wait block (waiting, completed, cancelled)
